title.zh: Tornado Cash联创：美国财政部承认混币器规则存在错误
title.en: Tornado Cash联创：美国财政部承认混币器规则存在错误

current_state.zh: 司法部继续在纽约南区推进对 Roman Storm 的指控，并以 Bitcoin Fog 上诉案支持管辖地主张；财政部 FinCEN 撤回混币器报告规则提案；案件未受影响，重审定于2027年4月26日。
current_state.en: DOJ continues prosecuting Roman Storm in SDNY and cites the Bitcoin Fog appeal to support venue; Treasury/FinCEN is withdrawing the proposed mixer-reporting rule; the criminal case remains active with retrial scheduled for April 26, 2027.

updates.title_zh: Tornado Cash联创：美国财政部承认混币器规则存在错误
updates.title_en: Tornado Cash联创：美国财政部承认混币器规则存在错误
updates.what_changed_zh: Tornado Cash 联合创始人 Roman Storm 表示，美国财政部承认其混币器规则存在缺陷，并对合法活动造成了寒蝉效应，而美国司法部继续在纽约南区法院提交新文件，推动对其定罪。
updates.what_changed_en: Tornado Cash co-founder Roman Storm says the US Treasury acknowledged its mixer rules were flawed and caused a chilling effect on legitimate activity, while the DOJ continues to press for his conviction with a new filing in SDNY.
updates.current_state_zh: Tornado Cash 联合创始人 Roman Storm 表示，美国财政部承认其混币器规则存在缺陷，并对合法活动造成了寒蝉效应，而美国司法部继续在纽约南区法院提交新文件，推动对其定罪。

updates.title_zh: 美财政部放弃混币器报告计划，司法部继续推进 Tornado Cash 起诉
updates.title_en: DOJ presses Tornado Cash prosecution as Treasury drops mixer reporting plan
updates.what_changed_zh: 美国司法部于10月5日致函法院，援引 Bitcoin Fog 案上诉来为在纽约审理 Roman Storm 的两项指控辩护；FinCEN 同日提交撤回2023年混币器强化报告规则的通知；重审仍定于2027年4月26日。
updates.what_changed_en: DOJ filed an Oct. 5 letter citing the Bitcoin Fog appeal to defend New York venue for two counts against Roman Storm, while FinCEN filed notice to withdraw its 2023 enhanced mixer-reporting rule; retrial remains scheduled for April 26, 2027.
updates.current_state_zh: 司法部继续在纽约南区推进对 Roman Storm 的指控，并以 Bitcoin Fog 上诉案支持管辖地主张；财政部 FinCEN 撤回混币器报告规则提案；案件未受影响，重审定于2027年4月26日。
updates.current_state_en: DOJ continues prosecuting Roman Storm in SDNY and cites the Bitcoin Fog appeal to support venue; Treasury/FinCEN is withdrawing the proposed mixer-reporting rule; the criminal case remains active with retrial scheduled for April 26, 2027.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The DOJ filed an Oct. 5 letter citing a Bitcoin Fog appeal to defend New York venue for two counts against Tornado Cash co-founder Roman Storm, as Treasury moved to withdraw FinCEN's proposed mixer-reporting rule, leaving the criminal case and Storm's April 26, 2027 retrial schedule unaffected.
updates.detailed_summary_en: The DOJ filed an Oct. 5 letter citing a Bitcoin Fog appeal to defend New York venue for two counts against Tornado Cash co-founder Roman Storm, as Treasury moved to withdraw FinCEN's proposed mixer-reporting rule, leaving the criminal case and Storm's April 26, 2027 retrial schedule unaffected.
